name: payment_gateway_forward_listens
cmd: sh -lc 'caw payment gateway 118c2eae-4258-4b75-a36b-c2e1097890b0 --mode forward --protocol x402 --listen 127.0.0.1:8402 >/tmp/clear402_gateway_run.log 2>/tmp/clear402_gateway_err.log & pid=$!; sleep 3; lsof -nP -iTCP:8402 -sTCP:LISTEN || true; kill $pid; wait $pid || true; cat /tmp/clear402_gateway_run.log; cat /tmp/clear402_gateway_err.log'
